summaryZh: Fogler 研究组开展凝聚态理论研究，关注半导体、纳米结构、石墨烯及其他二维晶体的电子、激子、力学和等离激元性质，特别包括二维范德华材料中的等离激元与极化激元。
researchQuestions: 二维晶体及纳米结构的电子、激子和等离激元性质如何表现？
topics: 石墨烯与二维范德华晶体
等离激元、极化激元与激子

evidence.quote: Our group conducts research in condensed-matter theory. We study semiconductors, nanostructures, graphene, and other two-dimensional crystals. We are interested in electronic, excitonic, mechanic, and plasmonic properties of such materials. Our recent research highlights is a series of works on plasmons and polaritons in graphene and other 2D van der Waals crystals.
